# Variant Classification {#cpsr-variant-classification}

```{r classification_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

# Prepare a flat data frame of all classified variants for PDF output.
# Unlike the HTML report, this uses tinytable rather than reactable,
# and is limited to P/LP/VUS to keep the PDF focused.

variants_pdf <- cps_report$content$snv_indel$callset$variant_display$cpg_non_sf

n_path_lpath <- sum(
  variants_pdf$CLASSIFICATION %in% c("Pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic"),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
## VUS: protein-coding variants only in the PDF report (all VUS are listed
## in the HTML report and the Excel/TSV output)
vus_all_pdf <- variants_pdf[variants_pdf$CLASSIFICATION %in% "VUS", ,
                            drop = FALSE]
vus_coding <- if ("CODING_STATUS" %in% colnames(vus_all_pdf))
  vus_all_pdf$CODING_STATUS %in% "coding" else rep(TRUE, NROW(vus_all_pdf))
n_vus_pdf <- sum(vus_coding)
n_vus_noncoding_pdf <- NROW(vus_all_pdf) - n_vus_pdf
## maximum number of VUS listed in the PDF report
max_vus_pdf <- 20
panel_genes_pdf <- cps_report$settings$conf$gene_panel$panel_genes
n_panel_genes_pdf <- if ("PRIMARY_TARGET" %in% colnames(panel_genes_pdf)) {
  length(unique(panel_genes_pdf$SYMBOL[panel_genes_pdf$PRIMARY_TARGET %in% TRUE]))
} else length(unique(panel_genes_pdf$SYMBOL))
```

```{r classification_pdf_intro}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat(
  "Listed below are germline variants in the sample that were ",
  "found in the specified virtual panel of cancer predisposition genes (**n = ",
  n_panel_genes_pdf, "**, see *Analysis configuration & data sources*). ",
  "Pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants are shown, as well as ",
  "protein-coding variants of uncertain significance (VUS) - non-coding VUS ",
  "are listed in the HTML report and the Excel output only.\n\nVariants are classified using two ",
  "assertion authorities, *ClinVar* and *CPSR*'s internal ACMG/AMP variant ",
  "classification routine [@Richards2015-kj; @Nakken2021-mb]; ",
  "with the one taking precedence being dictated by the user-defined *ClinVar trust level*. ",
  "Benign/Likely Benign variants are not shown.\n\n", sep = "")
```

## Pathogenic and Likely Pathogenic variants {#cpsr-plp-variants}

```{r path_lpath_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr n_path_lpath > 0

variants_pdf |>
  dplyr::filter(
    CLASSIFICATION %in% c("Pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic")) |>
  cpsr:::variant_table_pdf()
```

```{r path_none_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_path_lpath == 0
cat(pcgrr::pdf_note(kind = "empty", paste0(
  "No pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants were found in the ",
  n_panel_genes_pdf, " genes of the virtual gene panel (see Analysis configuration & data sources).")))
```

## Variants of Uncertain Significance (protein-coding)

```{r vus_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr n_vus_pdf > 0

## protein-coding VUS, at most 20 - highest CPSR pathogenicity score first
vus_pdf <- vus_all_pdf[vus_coding, , drop = FALSE] |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$CPSR_PATHOGENICITY_SCORE), .data$SYMBOL)
vus_pdf |>
  utils::head(max_vus_pdf) |>
  cpsr:::variant_table_pdf()
```

```{r vus_capped_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_vus_pdf > max_vus_pdf
cat(
  "\n*Showing ", max_vus_pdf, " of ", n_vus_pdf, " protein-coding variants ",
  "of uncertain significance (highest CPSR pathogenicity score first) - the ",
  "complete list is available in the HTML report and the Excel output.*\n\n",
  sep = "")
```

```{r vus_none_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_vus_pdf == 0
cat(pcgrr::pdf_note(kind = "empty", paste0(
  "No protein-coding variants of uncertain significance were found in the ",
  n_panel_genes_pdf, " genes of the virtual gene panel.")))
```

```{r vus_noncoding_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_vus_noncoding_pdf > 0
cat(
  "\n*", n_vus_noncoding_pdf, " non-coding variant(s) of uncertain ",
  "significance not shown - listed in the HTML report and the Excel ",
  "output.*\n\n", sep = "")
```
